title: Use Seedance 2.5 LONG VIDEO with a single visual reference and a high-level…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 LONG VIDEO with a single visual reference and a high-level prompt (e.g., “Make a movie about connection and community”) to generate a ~2-minute short including dialogue at 720p.
Use the 30 sec clips option to generate videos as 30-second segments.
tips:

Usa la opción de clips de 30 sec para generar videos en segmentos de 30 segundos.
